roles.name: delivery-worker
roles.description: Smallest qualified role for a delivery-progress fact: the worker already holding the affected bead.

roles.name: mayor
roles.description: Escalation role for a Planning Run or adaptation-register fact, or a delivery fact with no dedicated worker role available.

exemptions.name: tactical-resolve-auto-handoff
exemptions.description: Auto-hand a tactical Planning Exception resolve to the delivery worker without Mayor review -- only when the decision is tactical and no Ticket Graph Draft patch is required. Restores (Mayor review required again) the instant either signal regresses.
